from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u066/system/state/workspace/programs/task-115c6a65.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter
from math import gcd
from functools import reduce

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    solid = Counter()
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            v = grid[r][c]
            if grid[r][c+1] == v and grid[r+1][c] == v and grid[r+1][c+1] == v:
                solid[v] += 1
    bg = max(counts, key=lambda v: (solid[v], counts[v]))
    base = max((v for v in counts if v != bg), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    special = {v for v in counts if v not in (bg, base)}
    mr = [r for r in range(h) if any(v in special for v in grid[r])]
    mc = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in special for r in range(h))]
    if len(mr) < 2 or len(mc) < 2:
        return [[bg]]
    dr = reduce(gcd, (b-a for a,b in zip(mr,mr[1:])))
    dc = reduce(gcd, (b-a for a,b in zip(mc,mc[1:])))
    r0, r1 = mr[0], mr[-1]
    c0, c1 = mc[0], mc[-1]
    rows = list(range(r0, r1 + 1, dr))
    cols = list(range(c0, c1 + 1, dc))
    if rows[-1] + dr < h:
        rows.append(rows[-1] + dr)
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line = []
        for ca, cb in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            a, b, c, d = grid[ra][ca], grid[ra][cb], grid[rb][ca], grid[rb][cb]
            line.append(a if a == b == c == d and a in special else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
